note: Yellow-billed Magpie: AviList spells nuttallii; TreeOfLife, BirdNET geo 3.0 and iNaturalist spell nuttalli. Same taxon.
American Barn Owl: AviList splits T. furcata from T. alba; BirdNET geo 3.0 has only Tyto alba (lumped). TreeOfLife has T. furcata itself, so no tol alias.
Northern Harrier: split from Hen Harrier. Only valid for observations in the Americas (our golden set is California); BirdNET has hudsonius itself.
Wapiti (MDD): North American observations labelled Cervus elaphus under the older lumped taxonomy. Only valid for North America.

Northern Harrier: TreeOfLife-200M has no hudsonius row; its Circus cyaneus (Hen Harrier) row is the lumped taxon incl. American photos. Shares that vector with AviList C. cyaneus, so the BirdNET prior (hudsonius vs cyaneus) decides by location.
